assets.source: rendehR SCI/SCID procedure classification (spinal cord injury research only; not a general procedure vocabulary). The ICD-10-PCS rows follow the 22 code patterns of a published classification (column icd10_code_pattern); the ICD-9-CM rows are rendehR's mapping of each ICD-10-PCS row to ICD-9-CM procedure codes.
assets.citation: ICD-10-PCS rows: a published set of SCI procedure code patterns (column icd10_code_pattern). ICD-9-CM mapping: Mussavi Rizi M, Shein V, Torres-Espin A. rendehR: a cohort-first, provenance-aware, agentic-ready pipeline for harmonizing multi-source electronic health records. medRxiv 2026 (preprint). doi:10.64898/2026.11.19.26367722
assets.license: GPL-3 for the rendehR ICD-9-CM mapping; the ICD-10-PCS patterns follow the cited source
assets.generation_method: 5,933 ICD-10-PCS codes classified by treatment category and body system from the 22 published code patterns; 5,933 ICD-9-CM rows mapped one to one from them (173 with no ICD-9-CM code)
assets.multiplicity: multiple procedure classifications per code and nine exact duplicate rows are kept
assets.limitations: 173 rows have no icd_code and are left out of the lookup at run time. A procedure missing from the list is not classified as nonoperative.

assets.source: CMS ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM code description files (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/icd-10-codes)
assets.edition: ICD-9-CM v23-v32 and ICD-10-CM FY2016-FY2025, union; title from the newest release with the code
assets.citation: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM code descriptions
assets.multiplicity: both ICD versions and official cross-version code collisions are preserved
assets.limitations: Codes retired before ICD-9-CM v28 carry the official short title. Not a gold standard for clinical meaning.
